items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in today’s practice, an indication he could return on Sunday.
items.why: Full participant after ankle issue; positive indication for return.
items.implication: Likely active Week 2; could reclaim or share RB role, impacting Rhamondre Stevenson/handcuffs.
items.opportunity: Potential expanded carries/routes if fully healthy.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday’s game vs. the Cardinals due to his glute injury. The team currently has no plans to place Darnold on IR.
items.why: Glute injury; early rule-out, no IR plans.
items.implication: Drew Lock starts; impacts SEA pass-catchers (JSN etc.) volume/efficiency short-term.

items.text: The Ravens are placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on Injured Reserve after he had wrist surgery to quicken the recovery process. He’s out four games.
items.implication: Opens targets/snaps for Bateman/Moore; Zay Flowers primary but secondary roles expand.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins was limited at practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury noted on Wednesday practice report.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday practice; soft-tissue risk for Week 2 vs CIN; could open more work for other HOU WRs if escalates.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice today due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury kept him out of Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Elevates concern for Week 2 availability; watch for limited/full later in week. Could boost other DEN RBs if out.

items.text: With new information early this week, 49ers and De’Zhaun Stribling make a smart decision and opt to repair his deltoid rupture. Surgery will allow a complete recovery and Stribling should be back in late November or early December.
items.why: Deltoid rupture repair for full recovery.
items.implication: Extended absence; boosts Deebo Samuel and Demarcus Robinson in SF WR corps.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes/targets for remaining SF WRs.

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges will be out for the season after undergoing surgery for a torn MCL.
items.implication: SF TE depth thins; more work potentially for Kittle or other options; roster move included Hodge promotion.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow told reporters he is dealing with back tightness and didn’t practice today. He got plenty of mental reps and expects to play Sunday.
items.why: Back tightness; self-reported expectation to play.
items.implication: Monitor but likely active; CIN pass game (Chase/Higgins) remains viable if he goes.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week. Kenneth Walker is a full grown man (MNF love/reaction after dominant performance).
items.why: Deebo top waiver amid Stribling absence; Walker praised as full-grown-man after workhorse MNF explosion.
items.implication: Add Deebo aggressively; lock in Walker as must-start RB1.
items.opportunity: Deebo role expansion in SF; Walker confirmed high-volume KC back.

items.text: Early Week 2 Injury Report for Waivers: Ladd McConkey = Tre’ Harris; Ja’Kobi Lane = Rashod Bateman, Chris Moore; A.J. Brown = Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas; De’Zhaun Stribling = Deebo Samuel, Demarcus Robinson; Alvin Kamara = Kendre Miller; plus others like Vele for Tyson, Wentz for Murray.
items.why: Direct injury beneficiaries listed with FAAB/streaming guidance; precise role expansions expected.
items.implication: Priority adds: Deebo (Stribling out long), Bateman (Lane IR), Miller (Kamara), Harris (McConkey), Douglas/Doubs (Brown).
items.opportunity: Immediate target/snap share increases for listed backups.

items.text: Sounds like Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has a legit chance to return Week 2 or 3. But this is the same left knee that sustained a PCL sprain and bone bruise last season. Scary.
items.why: Meniscus trim with coach positive comments, but prior PCL/bone bruise on same knee raises re-injury risk.
items.implication: Stash/hold; potential TE1 if returns soon, but caution on durability.

items.text: As expected, Kenneth Walker went to KC to be a true workhorse. Last night: Handled 29 of the first 32 RB opportunities; ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks; tied for team-high with 6 targets for a 22% share; 23-173-1 rushing, 3-18-1 receiving. He fucks.
items.why: Dominant early-down and receiving opportunities in debut; true workhorse role confirmed.
items.implication: Elite RB1 usage/ROS outlook in KC offense; start confidently weekly.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target/carry share including red-zone potential.

items.text: Rashee Rice has a tiny career average depth of target of 4.9 yards. Last night was 2.5 yards. Rice needs serious volume to pay off in box score. The two targets for a 7% share last night are notable. Routes were there though. On 33 Mahomes dropbacks: Worthy 30, Rice 29, Thornton 24.
items.why: Low aDOT and target share despite high route participation; volume-dependent profile.
items.implication: Floor risk without volume spike; routes support eventual WR2/3 upside if targets rise.
items.opportunity: High route share (29/33) but low targets; watch for expanded role.
items.conflict: Routes strong but box-score production limited by short targets/volume.

items.text: Bucky Irving's result yesterday (22.3 PPR points) was a bit overstated relative to usage. Only got 8 carries, scored a rush TD on one of those. Only ran 21 routes, saw 7 targets and caught all of them. Still, Bucky got the only RB carry inside the 10-yard line. Out-routed Gainwell 21-13. Looked extremely healthy. Very good matchup vs. CLE next.
items.why: TD-inflated score but positive efficiency, receiving work, sole GL carry, out-routed backup, healthy.
items.implication: Solid RB2/flex with upside; strong Week 2 matchup supports start.
items.opportunity: Goal-line role + receiving (7 targets/21 routes) over Gainwell.
items.conflict: Fantasy points overstated vs pure volume (only 8 carries).
